The sodiation of the carbon layer provides a capacity of 0.05 mAh/cm^2. 

The highest plating capacity demonstrated is 12 mAh/cm^2. 

The fraction of the capacity provided by the sodiation of the carbon layer compared to the highest plating capacity is 0.05/12 = 0.0042 or 0.42%.
